pr_title: ddl: support type conversion between non-varchar and varchar
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:

2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/24638 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

This PR allows changing column types between varchar and non-varchar.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: 

- Let `varchar <-> non-varchar` conversion need reorganization.
- Revert some test changed in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/23688.

### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`: 5.0

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

Side effects

- Performance regression: the type conversion between char and varchar consumes more time because the reorganization is needed.

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- support type conversion between non-varchar and varchar
pr_comments:
@mjonss Here is an example showing that even if ALTER `char` to `varchar` can cause data inconsistency:

To reproduce, we need to revert #23688 or remove the following code in master branch:

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/79669921ff2dab575fa3dba53d65c926481c03ff/ddl/ddl_api.go#L3624-L3627

Turn on the new collation.

```sql
create table t (a char(10), primary key (a) clustered, unique key idx(a));
insert into t values ('aaa  ');
alter table t modify column a varchar(20);

select * from t ignore index (idx);
+---+
| a |
+---+
| NULL |
+---+
select * from t use index (idx);
+-----+
| a   |
+-----+
| aaa |
+-----+
```

Since the primary key is clustered, column `a` is the row handle.

The secondary index `idx` needs to store the handle(column `a`) in the index value. The format of index value between `char` and `varchar` are different: the latter uses a number to represent the trailing spaces, the former does not have this optimization. 

Thus, conversion between `char` and `varchar` needs to rewrite the index value. Otherwise, the decoder cannot decode the data with the unmatched column type.

issue_context.title: Support column type conversion between non-varchar to varchar
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

We forbid changing column type conversion between non-varchar to varchar in master/v5.0.x(PR: #23688). Before #23688, this feature(conversion between char to varchar) was originally supported by modifying only the column structure without modifying the data.
However, it was later found that some scenarios(these cases are executed on the branch which before forbidding this feature) could not be handled in this way, such as:
```
tidb> create table t(a int, b varchar(10), primary key(a, b));
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)
tidb> insert into t values (1, "aaa   ");
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.00 sec)
tidb> alter table t change column b b char(10);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)
tidb> Create table t1 like t;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
tidb> insert into t1 values (1, "aaa   ");
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.01 sec)

tidb> select * from t;
+---+--------+
| a | b      |
+---+--------+
| 1 | aaa    |
+---+--------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
tidb> select * from t1;
+---+-----+
| a | b   |
+---+-----+
| 1 | aaa |
+---+-----+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

tidb> admin check table t;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)
```

Currently, we are working to support changing column types (not only changing column properties but also changing how column data is handled). This feature can also be supported by the way to modify the data which need to set`SET GLOBAL TIDB_ENABLE_CHANGE_COLUMN_TYPE = 1`. 


## Materials
[old way to column type change](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/docs/design/2018-10-08-online-DDL.md#modify-column-operation)
[new way to to column type change proposal](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/docs/design/2020-07-07-change-column-types.md)
Related to issue: #23624, #23852.

review_comments: It seems that this case duplicated with line488-490. Could we add `select` statement after line490 directly?

The first case shows consistency between index data and row data. The second case shows that it should get a different result in different types with the same data.

Let's keep it separate to clarify the problems.
